description: This file defines a PHP class 'LanguageHelper' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Util\V1'. The class provides methods for managing language strings, language groups, and language data within a Human Resource Management system. It interacts with a database using Doctrine DBAL and processes YAML files for language strings.

classes.name: LanguageHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing language strings and language data within the system. Handles reading YAML language files, database operations for language groups and translations, and provides methods for creating and deleting test language packs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: readLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from a YAML file and associates them with a specific group.

methods.name: getGroupIdByName
methods.description: Fetches the ID of an internationalization group by its name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: deleteLangStringByUnitId
methods.description: Deletes language strings by their unit ID, optionally filtered by group ID.

methods.name: insertTranslation
methods.description: Inserts or updates a translation for a specific language string ID and language ID.

methods.name: getLanguageIdByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves the ID for a language given its code.

methods.name: updateLanguageStatusByLangCode
methods.description: Updates the enabled and added status flags for a language identified by its code.

methods.name: createTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Creates a test language pack with language code 'zz_ZZ' and populates translations with a specific pattern.

methods.name: deleteTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Removes the test language pack and associated translations from the database.
